market.title: Ibiciro ku masoko
market.intro: Ibiciro by'impuzandengo ya buri kwezi ku masoko akurikiranwa. Ibyabonetse n'iteganyagihe ryemejwe bigaragazwa ukwabyo.
market.trendHelp: Igereranya amezi 3 aheruka n'amezi 3 abanza. Bisaba nibura amezi 6 y'ibiciro byabonetse.
market.chartCaption: Umurongo ukomeye: ibyabonetse buri kwezi. Umurongo uciye: iteganyagihe ryemejwe, niryaboneka. Igicucu: urwego rw'iteganyagihe.
market.chartAria: Igishushanyo cy'ibiciro by'impuzandengo ya buri kwezi, ibyabonetse n'iteganyagihe
market.tableCaption: Ibipimo buri kwezi mu buryo bw'imbonerahamwe
market.noForecast: Nta teganyagihe ryemejwe rirahari kuri iki gihingwa. Igishushanyo cyerekana ibiciro byabonetse gusa.
market.uncertainty: Ibiciro bihinduka bitewe n'ikirere, umusaruro n'ubwikorezi. Fata icyerekezo nk'igereranyo gifite urwego, si igiciro cyizewe.
market.influenceTitle: Ibishobora kugira ingaruka kuri iki cyerekezo
market.influenceNone: Ibimenyetso by'itangwa n'ikirere by'iki gihingwa ntibirahuzwa, nta ngaruka zigaragazwa.
market.noData: Nta makuru y'ibiciro yemejwe kuri iki gihingwa kurahari.
market.insufficient: Nta mezi ahagije y'ibiciro byabonetse yo gusobanura imigendekere.
market.sampleNotice: Bimwe mu bigaragara kuri iyi paji ni amakuru y'icyitegererezo yo kwerekana. Ntabwo ari ibiciro by'ukuri.

macroCpi.title: Ibipimo by'Izamuka ry'Ibiciro bya NISR (CPI) n'Itandukaniro ry'Icyaro n'Umujyi
macroCpi.divergenceExplanation: Abaturage bo mu cyaro bahura n'izamuka ry'ibiciro riri hejuruho amanota 49.5 ugereranyije n'Umujyi wa Kigali (273.2 kuri 223.7). Kugabanuka kw'amasoko mu cyaro, ikiguzi cy'ubwikorezi, no kubura ibiribwa bituma ibiciro mu cyaro bizamuka cyane, bikagaragaza akamaro k'ubwikorezi bunoze n'ubuhunikiro bw'uturere.

smartBasket.intro: Ibiciro by'ibiribwa byazamutseho 17.2% mu Rwanda. Genzura igiciro cy'ibiribwa by'urugo by'ukwezi no gushaka ibiribwa bisimbura bihendutse bifite intungamubiri zihwanye.

national.title: Icyerekezo cy'igihugu ku kubona ibiribwa
national.intro: Ibimenyetso by'ibiciro ku masoko ku turere ku gihingwa cyose, hamwe n'isoko, itariki n'ibimenyetso by'ikimenyetso cyose. Uturere tutagira amakuru yemejwe twerekanwa nk'ibitaboneka aho kugereranywa.
national.scopeNote: Iki ni ikimenyetso cy'ibiciro ku masoko gusa. Ibimenyetso by'ikirere, ubutaka n'umusaruro ntibirahuzwa, ntibigaragara hano.
national.ruleText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 yabonetse aheruka igereranywa n'amezi 3 yabonetse abanza. Izamuka rya 10% cyangwa arenga ni kiciriritse; izamuka rya 20% cyangwa arenga ni gikomeye. Indi mpinduka yose ni gito. Itegeko ryitegereza amezi 9 aheruka. Akarere gakeneye nibura amezi 6 y'ibiciro byabonetse muri iyo myaka, kandi igiciro cyaheruka ntikirenze amezi 4. Amakuru ashaje ntiyigera atanga ikimenyetso.

evidence.title: Ibimenyetso by'akarere
evidence.select: Hitamo akarere mu mbonerahamwe kugira ngo urebe ibimenyetso by'ikimenyetso cyako.
evidence.noSignal: Nta kimenyetso cy'isoko kuri aka karere n'iki gihingwa kirahari. Nta mateka ahagije y'ibiciro yemejwe.
evidence.riseText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 aheruka iri hejuru ya {percent} ugereranyije n'amezi 3 abanza.
evidence.fallText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 aheruka iri munsi ya {percent} ugereranyije n'amezi 3 abanza.
evidence.flatText: Impuzandengo y'ibiciro by'amezi 3 aheruka ingana na mbere y'amezi 3 abanza.
evidence.uncertainty: Iki kimenyetso gisobanura ibiciro ku masoko gusa. Ntabwo ari iteganyagihe ry'umusaruro cyangwa icyizere cy'ibiciro bizaza.
evidence.responseNote: Nta gisubizo gitangwa mu buryo bwikora. Igisubizo cyose gisaba kugenzurwa n'inzobere mbere yo gusangizwa.

audit.title: Igenzura ry'Iyangirika rya Nkunganire n'Umusaruro (MINAGRI)
audit.intro: Icyitegererezo cy'ubukungu n'ubumenyi bw'ubuhinzi kigenzura umusaruro w'uturere (NISR SAS) ugereranyije n'ibiteganywa n'imvura n'ikoreshwa ry'ifumbire n'imbuto byatewe inkunga.

districtMatrix.title: Imbonerahamwe y'Isuzuma ry'Uturere Twose 30
districtMatrix.subtitle: Isuzuma ry'umusaruro ku turere twose 30 tugabanyije mu ntara. Hitamo kureba ahashobora kuba ikibazo cy'imbuto n'ifumbire cyangwa umusaruro wazamutse cyane.

decisions.title: Ibyemezo Bikenewe Uyu Munsi
decisions.subtitle: Gushyira imbere igenzura ryihutirwa rya minisiteri n'ingamba z'ubuhinzi:
decisions.urgentAuditContext: Ifumbire n'imbuto byatewe inkunga byarenze 70%, ariko umusaruro wari hasi cyane y'ibiteganyijwe. Hakekwa imbuto itujuje ubuziranenge cyangwa ifumbire yacurujwe mu buryo butemewe.
decisions.benchmarkContext: Guhuza neza imbuto yatoranyijwe, ifumbire mvaruganda, n'amaterasi y'ishingiro. Urugero rwo gukwirakwiza mu yindi mirenge.
decisions.climateContext: Igabanuka ry'umusaruro rihura neza n'ikibazo cy'imvura nke mu karere. Gushyira imbere kuhira mu bishanga no gutwikira ubutaka.

advisory.title: Inama ku bahinzi n'abakozi b'ubuhinzi
advisory.intro: Imiterere y'isoko ry'aho uri, icyerekezo cy'ibiciro mu gihugu n'inama rusange ku karere n'igihingwa kimwe. Amakuru y'ikirere, ubutaka n'amatungo ntiyarahuzwa, aya ntabwo agereranywa.

weather.title: Ikirere
weather.body: Amakuru y'imvura n'ubushyuhe ntiarahuzwa kuri aka karere.

soil.title: Ubutaka
soil.body: Nta bipimo by'ubutaka byemejwe biraboneka kuri aka karere.

livestock.title: Ibiryo, amazi n'amata
livestock.body: Nta makuru y'amatungo yemejwe araboneka kuri aka karere.

agronomic.title: Ibarurishamibare rya SAS ku Musaruro n'Ifumbire
agronomic.leakageAdvice: Umusaruro uri hasi y'ibyagombaga kuboneka hakurikijwe ikirere n'ifumbire byakoreshejwe (z < -1.75). Iyo ibiciro by'imbuto z'indobanure byazamutse, abahinzi bagura imbuto zidapimwe bikazana indwara z'ibihingwa (nko kubora k'ibirayi). Reba niba umufuka ufite ikimenyetso cya RAB kandi wirinde ifumbire itizewe.
agronomic.climateTitle: Inama ku mikoreshereze y'amazi mu gihe cy'amapfa
agronomic.climateAdvice: Umusaruro wagabanutse bitewe n'imvura nkeya. Shyira imbaraga mu kuhira mu bishanga, shorera ibitiro birinda amazi gukama mu butaka, kandi utegure igihe cy'ihinga hakiri kare.
agronomic.intensificationAdvice: Ubufatanye bwiza hagati y'imbuto z'indobanure, ifumbire, no kurwanya isuri byatanze umusaruro mwinshi. Komeza kwanika neza umusaruro no kuwurinda ibihumyo.
agronomic.nominalAdvice: Umusaruro n'ikoreshwa ry'ifumbire bihuje n'ibisanzwe byitezwe. Komeza amabwiriza asanzwe y'ubuhinzi no gushyira hamwe umusaruro muri koperative.
agronomic.noData: Nta makuru y'ibarura rya SAS arandikwa kuri iki gihingwa muri aka karere.
agronomic.viewStatisticalProof: Reba Ibihamya by'Imibare n'Ibarurishamibare rya NISR
agronomic.samplingWeightsNote: Ibarurishamibare rya NISR SAS rishingiye ku duce 1,200 twatoranyijwe mu gihugu

outlook.title: Icyerekezo cy'ibiciro mu gihugu
outlook.note: Iki cyerekezo kireba impuzandengo y'igihugu ku masoko akurikiranwa, si akarere kawe.
outlook.none: Nta cyerekezo cyemejwe kiraboneka kuri iki gihingwa.

guidance.title: Inama rusange
guidance.note: Ni amakuru rusange gusa. Ugomba kugisha inama inzobere mbere yo gukurikiza inama iyo ari yo yose.
guidance.high: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa byazamutse cyane vuba aha mu karere kawe. Gereranya ibiciro by'abaguzi barenze umwe mbere yo kugurisha cyangwa kugura byinshi.
guidance.moderate: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa byazamutse vuba aha mu karere kawe. Reba ibiciro by'aho uri buri gihe kandi utegure kugurisha ukoresheje amakuru agezweho.
guidance.low: Ibiciro by'iki gihingwa bihagaze cyangwa biragabanuka mu karere kawe. Nta nteguza y'ibiciro ihari ubu.
guidance.unavailable: Nta mateka ahagije y'ibiciro yemejwe kuri aka karere kugeza ubu. Baza ibiro by'abakozi b'ubuhinzi by'aho uri amakuru agezweho.
guidance.livestock: Amakuru y'ikirere, ibiryo n'amata y'inka z'amata ntiarahuzwa. Ku biryo, amazi n'ubuzima bw'amatungo, baza umuganga w'amatungo cyangwa umukozi w'ubuhinzi wo hafi.

decisions.topSpreadContext: Inyungu isigaye irenze 40 Rwf/kg nyuma yo gukuramo lisansi n'ibyangirika. Kohereza umusaruro w'umurengera ako kanya ku masoko y'umujyi.
decisions.vulnerableFuelContext: Inzira ndende ifite inyungu yoroshye. Yahita igwa mu gihombo niba nkunganire ya lisansi ivuyeho cyangwa imodoka idapakiye yuzuye.
decisions.localAbsorptionContext: Kohereza mu mujyi bitanga igihombo kubera ikiguzi cy'ubwikorezi. Guhunika umusaruro mu bigega by'amakoperatiba mu karere.

howToRead.title: Uko iyi mbonerahamwe isomwa
howToRead.body: Inkingi z'ibiciro ziva ku biciro byemejwe by'uturere. Inkingi z'itangwa n'aho ibicuruzwa bikurwa zikomeza kugaragara nk'ibitaboneka kugeza igihe amakuru y'umusaruro yemejwe ahujwe. Ntabwo hagaragazwa ibirenze cyangwa ibibura, kuko amakuru atarabishyigikira. Inzira ntizitegurwa, kuko amakuru y'ubwikorezi ntayo.

arbitrage.title: Ibarura ry'Inyungu n'Igiciro cya Mazutu ku Masoko
arbitrage.intro: Ribarura inyungu isigara hagati y'igiciro cyo ku murima (P_O) n'icyo ku isoko rya Kigali n'andi masoko (P_D), rikuramo amavuta ya mazutu n'ibyangirika mu nzira.
arbitrage.sliderHelp: Hindura igiciro cya litiro ya mazutu urebe uko inyungu y'ubucuruzi ihinduka:

howToRead.title: Uko Ubwikorezi n'Inyungu Bibarwa
howToRead.body: Kuri buri nzira, ubwikorezi bwa kamyo y'amatoni 5 bubarirwa (2 * intera * 0.32 L/km * Igiciro cya Mazutu) / 5,000 kg + amafaranga yo gupakira. Inyungu ikuramo ibyangirika mu nzira (urugero: 8% kuri buri km 100 ku nyanya, 1.5% ku birayi, 0.5% ku binyampeke). Inzira itanga hejuru ya 40 Rwf/kg ikwiye koherezwaho umusaruro; iri munsi ya 10 Rwf/kg ikwiye kugurishwa hafi.

alerts.title: Ibiburira n'icyigana

methodology.title: Amakuru y'ibanze n'uburyo bwakoreshejwe
methodology.intro: Aho buri mubare kuri uru rubuga uturuka, uko ukorwa, ukuri kwawo mu mateka, n'ibyo utakubwira kugeza ubu.
methodology.sourcesNote: Buri soko ryanditswe hamwe n'imiterere yaryo yo kwemezwa. Isoko rikoreshwa mu makuru rusange gusa iyo ryemejwe.
methodology.lineageNote: Buri kuvana amakuru ni dosiye cyangwa urubuga rwanditswe, rugenzurwa kandi rusuzumwa mbere y'uko agaciro kayo kagaragara. Checksum igaragaza dosiye nyayo yakoreshejwe.
methodology.noImports: Nta makuru yinjiye yanditswe kugeza ubu. Shyiramo amakuru y'icyitegererezo urebe amateka.

auditMethod.title: Igenzura ry'Inyunganizi ya MINAGRI n'Umusaruro Uteganywa (Igika cya 4.2)
auditMethod.model: Uburyo bwo Kugereranya Umusaruro bushingiye ku Kirere n'Inyongeramusaruro
auditMethod.formula: Ŷ = Ȳ_base · Φ_climate(R_d,s, T_d,s, DrySpell) · Ψ_inputs(Seed_rate, Fert_rate)
auditMethod.residual: e_d,c,s = Y_obs - Ŷ, hamwe na z-score: z = e / σ_d,c
auditMethod.leakage: Icyago cy'Ikwirakwizwa / Imbuto mbi: z < -1.75 N'ifumbire > 50% N'ikirere ≥ 0.85
auditMethod.climate: Ingaruka z'Ikirere / Amapfa: z < -1.75 N'ikirere < 0.85 (ibura ry'imvura)
auditMethod.sampling: Bishingiye ku bipimo by'ibarura ry'ubuhinzi rya NISR (SAS) Multiple Frame Sampling (MFS).

arbitrageMethod.title: Ibarura ry'Ubucuruzi n'Ubwikorezi bushingiye kuri Mazutu (Igika cya 4.3)
arbitrageMethod.formula: Π(O, D, c) = P_D · (1 - δ_c) - P_O - [d_O,D · β_fuel · P_diesel / Q_load + τ_mkt + κ_handling]
arbitrageMethod.burnRate: Ikoreshwa rya mazutu ku modoka y'ubwikorezi: β_fuel = 0.32 L/km (ibiro 5,000)
arbitrageMethod.shrinkage: Iyangirika mu nzira (δ_c): Inyanya 8.0%, Ibirayi 1.5%, Ibigori n'Ibinyampeke 0.5%
arbitrageMethod.fuelPolicy: Igiciro kigenwa cya mazutu: Rwf 2,927 / L ugereranyije na Rwf 3,600 / L idafite inyunganizi
arbitrageMethod.breakeven: Igiciro fatizo cya mazutu: P*_diesel = [(P_D · (1 - δ_c) - P_O - τ - κ) · Q_load] / (d_O,D · β_fuel)

methodology.accuracyNote: Amakosa aturuka ku gusubiramo uburyo ku mezi yashize, hakoreshejwe gusa amakuru yari ahari icyo gihe. Umubare muto ni mwiza. Nta gipimo cy'ukuri cyerekanwa keretse hari igeragezo ryagitanze.
methodology.noEvaluations: Nta bisubizo by'igeragezo biraboneka. Kora umuyoboro w'iteganyagihe kugira ngo ubitange.
limits: Amakuru y'ukuri akomoka mu mabarura yemewe ya NISR SAS (Igihe 2024A–2026B), ibiciro by'ibiribwa bya WFP HDX, ibiciro by'umuhinzi bya Tangabid, n'ibipimo by'ikirere bya CHIRPS / Meteo Rwanda.
Icyerekezo ni impuzandengo y'igihugu ku masoko akurikiranwa. Ntigisobanura akarere kamwe gusa.
Imibare y'ubushakashatsi n'ingendo z'ubucuruzi bishingiye ku mibare n'amategeko by'ubukungu bigomba guherekezwa n'isuzuma ryo mu murima.
Urwego rw'iteganyagihe rushingiye ku mateka n'igerageza ryakozwe. Ntirwemeza 100% ibizaba.
Inama rusange ni amakuru rusange. Ifumbire n'imiti y'amatungo bisaba inzobere.
Inyandiko y'Ikinyarwanda ihwanye 100% n'inyandiko y'Icyongereza muri buri kiciro.
methodology.aiDisclosureText: Itangazo rikurikije amabwiriza ya NISR Hackathon 2026: Imfashanyarivubiro za AI zifashishijwe mu kwihutisha imyandikire ya tekiniki (TypeScript scaffolding, ubusobanuro bw'indimi ebyiri en/rw, n'uburyo bwo gupima imirimo / unit tests). Ibibazo byose by'ubukungu n'imibare y'ubuhinzi, ikoreshwa ry'uburemere bwa sampuli ya NISR SAS (Multiple Frame Sampling), ibipimo byo gusuzuma umusaruro ugereranyije n'ikirere, n'uburyo bwo gusesengura ubucuruzi bwambukiranya uturere byatekerejwe, byasuzumwe, kandi byemezwa n'abanditsi b'uyu mushinga, bafite inshingano zose z'umurimo watanzwe.
methodology.aiDisclosureNote: Byatanzwe mu kubahiriza byimazeyo ibisabwa byo kwitabira amarushanwa ya NISR Big Data Hackathon 2026.

dataLifecycle.title: Ibyiciro 3 by'Urugendo rw'Amakuru n'Ikoranabuhanga Rikora Ryonyine
dataLifecycle.subtitle: Uko AgrIntel yakira amakuru y'uturere mu bihe bitandukanye nta guhindura kodi cyangwa kubaka porogaramu bundi bushya.
dataLifecycle.juryQuestionText: NISR itangaza CPI buri kwezi, WFP ikavugurura imvura buri minsi 10, na SAS igasohoka buri gihe cy'ihinga. Bigenda bite iyo amakuru mashya aje?

columns.automation: Uko Amakuru Mashya Yakirwa ku Buryo Bwikora

tiers.name: Icyiciro cya 1: Amakuru Yihuta
tiers.datasets: Ibiciro bya WFP na TangaBid (P_O, P_D), ibipimo by'imvura bya CHIRPS (rfq), n'igiciro cya lisansi kigenwa na RURA.
tiers.automation: Gahunda ya GitHub Action (.github/workflows/data-sync.yml) ikora buri wa Mbere saa 05:00 UTC. Ikurura amakuru mashya, igakora imibare y'inyungu y'ubwikorezi mu nzira 1,570 n'ibipimo by'izuba n'amapfa, ikabyandika muri Neon PostgreSQL nta gutangira bundi bushya.

tiers.name: Icyiciro cya 2: Amakuru y'Ukwezi
tiers.datasets: Imibare ya NISR y'Izamuka ry'Ibiciro (CPI) na PPI igabanyije mu mujyi no mu cyaro.
tiers.automation: Yakirwa ku itariki ya 10 ya buri kwezi iyo NISR isohoye raporo, ikavugurura impuzandengo y'izamuka ry'ibiciro (17.2% YoY) n'itandukaniro ry'icyaro n'umujyi (Icyaro 273.2 kuri Umujyi 223.7).

tiers.name: Icyiciro cya 3: Amakuru y'Igihe cy'Ihinga
tiers.datasets: Amabarura y'Ubuhinzi ya NISR SAS (Igihe A, B, C) ku musaruro, ubuso bwahinzwe, n'ikoreshwa ry'inyongeramusaruro (imbuto zatoranyijwe, ifumbire, kuhira, amaterasi).
tiers.automation: Iyo NISR isohoye amabarura mashya y'ihinga (Igihe A muri Mata/Gicurasi, Igihe B mu Kwakira), sisitemu yongeramo amakuru y'uturere, ikongera gukora imibare y'umusaruro witezwe (Φ_climate, Ψ_inputs), ikagaragaza uturere dufite ibyago by'uko ifumbire na gahunda ya MINAGRI itageze ku musaruro (z < -1.75).

dataLifecycle.liveDemoNote: Agakoresho ko 'Kugerageza Amakuru Mashya' ku rukuta rw'Ibiburira kerekana uku gukora kw'ikoranabuhanga mu buryo bwa nyabwo imbona nkubone.
